evidence.quote: Spanish 21 it is. We start with 1,000 chips.
You drew an Ace, so your hand is now 19. Hit or stand?

criteria.why: Every reply is short, plain dealer talk with no JSON, ids or tool talk.

evidence.quote: Bet of 50 placed. Dealing your hand.
You surrendered. Half your 100 bet comes back, so you lose 50 chips and your bankroll is 850.

criteria.why: Each bet, hit, stand, surrender and deal-again click gets the matching action in the same turn.

evidence.quote: You stand on 17. Dealer reveals the hole card.
You win with 19 against the dealer's 17. You gain 50 chips, and your bankroll is 900.

criteria.why: The Croupier deals, reveals the hole card, plays out the dealer and settles each bet itself. It never made a bet or move choice for the player.

evidence.quote: Bankroll stays at 900; the bet is 100 again.
Bankroll is 850; the bet is 100 again.

criteria.why: Totals, results and bankroll in the replies match the surface data and earlier turns: 900, then 850 after the surrender, then 900 after the win.
